summary: Approval-resume and permission-scope failures block safe task completion.
issues: P1: Approved approvals never resume. control.py records the decision but leaves the task WAITING_FOR_USER_APPROVAL; supervisor.py has no branch that launches main for that state, so tasks remain stuck after approval.
P1: main.py ignores the False return from apply_scoped_permissions and continues to implementation even when scoped write permissions were not applied.
evidence: python -m unittest discover -s automation/tests -v passed: 99 tests.
Supervisor only dispatches QUEUED, WAITING_FOR_QUOTA, RESUMING, and legacy APPROVED_TO_COMMIT states.
next_instruction: Resume the worker when an approval decision is available (or transition state in control.py), and fail closed when scoped-permission setup fails. Add regression tests for both paths.
